Based on the National Archives data, here are the signers who meet all your criteria:

**7 signers died before the Treaty of Paris (Sept 3, 1783), were born in the American colonies, and never became president:**

| Name | State | Birthplace | Date of Death |
|------|-------|------------|---------------|
| **John Hart** | NJ | Hunterdon Co., NJ | 5/11/1779 |
| **Joseph Hewes** | NC | Kingston, NJ | 10/10/1779 |
| **Philip Livingston** | NY | Albany, NY | 6/12/1778 |
| **Thomas Lynch Jr.** | SC | Prince George's Parrish, SC | c. 1779 |
| **John Morton** | PA | Ridley Township, PA | c. 1777 |
| **George Ross** | PA | New Castle, DE | 7/14/1779 |
| **Richard Stockton** | NJ | Princeton, NJ | 2/28/1781 |
